EN: Come to me for info? Well a war of cults is brewin' out there, with Settlers caught in the crossfire.
ZH: 来向我打听情报？外面正在酝酿一场邪教间的战争，定居者被夹在交火之中。

EN: Famine and Pestilence are out there, whoever they are, with followers to spare. War and Death are the other infamous Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Are they terrorizing the Wasteland as well? If anyone knows, it's Three Dog at Galaxy News Radio. Let's go talk to him.
ZH: “饥荒”和“瘟疫”就在那里，无论他们是谁，追随者都大有人在。“战争”和“死亡”是臭名昭著的“末日骑士”。他们在废土肆虐吗？如果有人知道，一定是银河新闻电台的三狗。我们去跟他谈谈。

EN: If I were a conniving Coach, where would I be? Maybe in the gym of Harriet Tubman High School? It's worth a shot...
ZH: 如果我是那个狡猾的教练，我会去哪儿呢？也许会去哈丽特塔布曼高中的体育馆吧？那地方值得一试……

EN: A band of Raiders known as the Snakes has been targeting Settlers with red hair, calling them “gingers” and claiming they are inferior beings. We need to drive these Snakes out of the neighborhood, for good!
ZH: 一伙被称为“蛇”的掠夺者正在针对红头发的定居者，称他们为“生姜”，声称他们是下等人种。我们得把这些人赶走。

EN: Two Alpha Deathclaws have decided to make their home at the old Grotton Depot. Yikes! Time to bring out the big guns!
ZH: 两只领头死爪决定把旧的格罗顿仓库当做他们的家。太可怕！是时候拿出大家伙（枪）了！

EN: A pair of Glowing Ones have taken over an old Fusion Core factory. Toss those Ghouls out on their keisters!
ZH: 两只发光种占领了一处旧的聚变核心工厂。赶紧解决掉他们。

EN: Two Glowing Radroaches have chased the residents of the “Nuclear Arms Apartments” out of their home. Time for a little exterminating.
ZH: 两只发光辐射蟑螂把“核子武器公寓”的居民赶出了家门。是时候杀杀虫了。

EN: Thank goodness you're here! We're no match for those chitinous creeps! Take them down for us? Please?
ZH: 谢天谢地你在这里！我们可不是这些硬壳怪物的对手！能帮我们消灭它们吗？求求你们了！

EN: If you came for the dog food, you're out of luck. Those momma Mole rats were hungry. Take care of them, will ya?
ZH: 如果你们是为了狗粮来的，那么可不走运了。那些鼹鼠妈妈可是饿了，你们帮我们解决下吧？

EN: Two Mole rat brood mothers have been spotted at the nearby dog food factory. It's about time someone took them down.
ZH: 两只鼹鼠妈妈被发现出现在了附近的狗粮工厂。是时候有人拿下它们了。

EN: We've discovered the remains of a secret Enclave base. What strange and horrifying stuff will we find?
ZH: 我们发现了一座秘密英克雷基地的遗址。不知道能找到什么奇怪又骇人的东西？

EN: Uh… It says "Ping sent to all other Enclave servers." That's probably not great. Let's get out of here!
ZH: 呃……上面写着“已向所有其他英克雷服务器发送了ping信号。”那恐怕不太好。咱们撤吧！

EN: The first Enclave location on our list is an old Vault-Tec vault. They're probably doing something really sinister, sullying our pristine walls and morals.
ZH: 我们清单上的第一个英克雷据点是一座旧避难所科技避难所。他们八成在搞什么阴险勾当，玷污了我们洁净的墙壁与道德准则。

EN: Our metal detectors picked up a heavy signal of pure gold at a nearby megastore building. Could be worth checking out!
ZH: 我们的金属探测器在附近一座大型商场建筑里捕捉到了纯金的强烈信号。值得去查查看！

EN: We've discovered an active Enclave base! Let's bring the fight to them, before they finish whatever horrible thing they're planning.
ZH: 我们发现了一座活跃的英克雷基地！我们主动出击吧，赶在他们完成那可怕计划之前。

EN: We've intercepted a coded plea from someone seeking to break from the Enclave. They're holed up in a civilian outpost ripe for infiltration.
ZH: 我们截获了一段密码求援，来自一个想脱离英克雷的人。他们躲在一处适合渗透的民用哨站里。

EN: How insulting! You youngsters have it easy with... err... your tiny Radscorpions and friendly Radroaches...
ZH: 真没礼貌！你们这些年轻人日子好过多了，靠着……呃……你们那小小的辐射蝎和友善的辐射蟑螂……

EN: Throw 'em in a vat for all I care! Oh, alright! I don't need my uniform anymore, I guess. Take it and leave.
ZH: 把他们扔进培养大桶里我都不在乎！噢，好吧！我想我再也用不上我的制服了。拿去然后快滚。

EN: Showed mercy to my enemy once. The next day, he rallied the survivors and struck back. Lost many friends.
ZH: 我曾对我的敌人慈悲过一次。第二天，他就集结幸存者反击回来。我失去了很多朋友。

EN: The restoration of America, but I'm out of time! You, you still have some life left in you. You do it.
ZH: 重建美利坚，可我没时间了！你，你还有命可活。这件事交给你了。

EN: You're a cruel one, threatening to toss your former best sniper to the street... Go on, break my heart!
ZH: 你真是个残忍的家伙，居然威胁要把你曾经最好的神枪手赶到大街上……去吧，伤我的心吧！

EN: I'll play dead. Pretend to hit me, make it look real. Oh, and if you can, get my pet. That crazy lady stole it from me.
ZH: 我来装死。假装打我，演得逼真点。对了，你要是能的话，帮我把宠物带回来。那个疯婆子把它抢走了。

EN: We've been invited to opening night of an Enclave play. It screams trap, but we can turn it into a golden opportunity!
ZH: 我们受邀参加英克雷一部戏剧的首演之夜。这明显是陷阱，但我们可以把它变成天赐良机！

EN: Error. Name of character is Horatio, who is the totally original author and director of this play. Remove youself.
ZH: 错误。角色名为霍雷肖，他是本剧完全原创的作者兼导演。请你自行退出。

EN: I take thee at thy word. Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized. Henceforth I never will be Romeo.
ZH: 只要你肯叫我一声爱人，我便重新受洗；从此不再是罗密欧。

EN: Just move the décor to the scene. Aim the spotlight at the actor. Pull the lever to lift the fairies in the air.
ZH: 把布景搬到场景里。把聚光灯对准演员。拉下杠杆，把精灵们升到空中。

EN: We caught an odd signal inviting Enclave to a refuge in a former NCR base located in a mausoleum. Worth a look.
ZH: 我们捕捉到一个奇怪的信号，邀请英克雷前往一处位于陵墓中的前NCR基地避难。值得去看看。

EN: Sniff. I have found gold, and... and... the... the Enclave tried to take it from me, and they're big meanies...
ZH: 呜咽。我找到了黄金，然后……然后……英克雷想把它抢走，他们都是大坏蛋……

EN: Then you'll be the one who gets shot, NCR lover! My friend here will surely reward you for siding with him.
ZH: 那你就是那个要挨枪子儿的人，NCR走狗！只要站到他那边去，我这位朋友肯定少不了你的赏。

EN: Exactly! Democracy brought to the Wasteland. You deserve my favorite gun. Take good care of Henrietta.
ZH: 正是！把民主带到废土。你配得上我最心爱的枪。好好照顾亨丽埃塔。

EN: We must be popular: we've got another distress call, this time from a defecting scientist named Wilzig. By now, it's clear none of these are a trap.
ZH: 我们一定很受欢迎：又收到了一个求救信号，这次来自一位名叫威尔齐格的叛逃科学家。事到如今，很明显这些都不是陷阱。

EN: Intel says the Enclave's coming for us with something big, but we're already one step ahead. First stop: a lab running twisted experiments on animals.
ZH: 情报显示英克雷正带着个“大家伙”冲我们而来，但我们已抢先一步。第一站：一座拿动物搞变态实验的实验室。

EN: We've detected a foreign substance in our power supply. We traced the toxin back to an Enclave research bunker.
ZH: 我们在电力供应中检测到一种外来物质。我们一路追查毒素，追到了一座英克雷研究地堡。

EN: Our spies report the Enclave is breeding abominations to field as soldiers. There's still time to shut them down.
ZH: 我们的间谍报告说，英克雷正在培育怪物作为士兵投入战场。现在阻止他们还来得及。

EN: The Enclave is preparing their greatest threat yet: nuclear weapons. We must stop them before it's too late.
ZH: 英克雷正筹备他们有史以来最大的威胁：核武器。我们必须趁还来得及阻止他们。

EN: Woah, a real Enclave nuclear control center. And it's irradiated! GOLDAS ghoulified its own officers...
ZH: 哇，一座货真价实的英克雷核弹控制中心。而且它被辐射了！GOLDAS竟把自己的军官都变成了尸鬼……

EN: We found an Enclave citadel that may hold important databases for GOLDAS. Hopefully it's not just a wild Mole rat chase.
ZH: 我们发现了一座英克雷要塞，里面可能存有GOLDAS的重要数据库。希望这不是一场白忙活的“捉鼹鼠行动”。

EN: We found a secret entrance in the first abandoned Enclave base we explored. Let's see if there's also secret info!
ZH: 我们在最初探索的那座废弃英克雷基地里发现了一个秘密入口。看看是否也有秘密情报！

EN: We have finally located GOLDAS' main server! Let's shut down that weirdo AI once and for all. And take their gold.
ZH: 我们终于定位到GOLDAS的主服务器了！让我们一劳永逸地关停那个怪咖AI吧。顺便拿走他们的黄金。

EN: We've been invited to the Children of Atom's annual Deathclaw Egg Hunt! This is a good opportunity to validate Brother Will's claims that the Church plans to detonate a large nuclear bomb on E-Ster Sunday...
ZH: 我们被邀请参加原子之子一年一度的死爪蛋寻宝活动！这是验证威尔修士说法的好机会——教会打算在复活节当天引爆一枚大型核弹……

EN: Confessor Alvarado has agreed to put a stop to radioactive spraying, and as a sign of goodwill we've agreed to help the Church recover a sacred circuit board rumored to contain data about the ancient rite of E-Ster.
ZH: 忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多已同意停止喷洒辐射物质，作为善意的表示，我们已经同意帮助教会找回一块传说存有古老复活节仪式数据的圣电路板。

EN: The Dino Dee-Lite motel in Novac was once a bustling hub, now overrun with raiders who call themselves Khans. We're going to turn it back into a motel.
ZH: 诺瓦克的恐龙迪莱特汽车旅馆曾经是一处繁华的据点，如今却被一群自称大汗帮的掠夺者所占据。我们要把它还原成一家旅馆。

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers stumbled upon a Super-Duper Mart. Surely there's something useful inside.
ZH: 一位探索废土的居民途经了一个大无敌超市。里面应该会有些有用的东西。

EN: Some strange signals are interfering with our radio transmissions out in the waste. Take a squad with you and triangulate the interference. Once you know where it's coming from, investigate the site and disable whatever is blocking our Radio.
ZH: 废土中有一些奇怪的信号干扰了我们的无线电传输。带上一队人马，定位干扰源。一旦知道干扰信号的来源，就去调查那个地方，处理掉干扰我们无线电的东西。

EN: The information we got from Harkness is troubling: it reveals a rival Vault Overseer is behind all of the recent attacks against us. We need to send a single assassin to infiltrate the Vault and take out its leader... with extreme prejudice.
ZH: 我们从哈克尼斯那里收到的信息令人担忧：一位同我们竞争的避难所监督者是最近所有攻击的幕后黑手。我们需要派一名刺客潜入他们的避难所，毫不留情地干掉他们的首领。

EN: While exploring, Dwellers found a note warning everyone to stay away from an old industrial complex. If folks have kept clear, it might still hold something useful.
ZH: 探索的居民发现了一张告示，警告大家远离一幢旧的工业基地。如果没人在那儿，说不定还会有有用的东西留下。

EN: She's my grandma, but careful, she's a biter. Papa was too until he lost his dentures. They both mean well! Call it tough love.
ZH: 她是我的外婆，但是小心，她会咬人。我外公也是，直到他丢了他的假牙。当然他们都是好心，我称之为“强悍的爱”。

EN: Sure is, but careful, she's a biter. Papa used to be until he lost his dentures. But they both mean well! I call it tough love.
ZH: 当然是了。但小心，她爱咬人。老爸以前也这样，直到他丢了假牙。当然他们都是好意，我管这叫“严厉的爱”。

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers came across a Red Rocket. Perhaps it's worth taking a look.
ZH: 一位居民在探索废土的时候发现了一处红火箭服务站。也许值得进去看一看。

EN: You've stumbled across a slipshod settlement called Filly, offering welcome to other wastelanders. Unfortunately, it seems to be occupied by a gang of raiders who have different ideas...
ZH: 你偶然来到了一个名为菲利的破败聚落，这个地方原本欢迎其他废土居民。不幸的是，这里似乎被一伙掠夺者占领了，他们有不同的想法……

EN: A frantic voice comes in over the radio. There's a settler out in the Wasteland who's in serious trouble! The clock's ticking...
ZH: 一个焦急的声音从广播里传来。在废土上有个定居者貌似遇到了大麻烦！时间不多了……

EN: Yes! That's the one. Left here and headed to that factory across the river to take out Road Rash and his gang of Raiders!
ZH: 没错！就是那个。离开这里然后去工厂，穿过小河，拿下“道路丘疹”和他那帮掠夺者团伙吧！

EN: Famed Minuteman, Preston Garvey, has gone missing! Search for clues to his whereabouts at his last known location.
ZH: 小有名气的义勇军民兵——普雷斯顿·加维，消失了！在他最后出现的地方寻找有关他去向的线索。

EN: People are talking about a new kind of water that has healing properties, makes you stronger and brings good fortune. Adventure! Action! Refreshing Beverages! We can drink to that!
ZH: 人们在谈论一种新的水，它具有治疗特性，能使你更强壮并带来好运。冒险！行动！提神的饮料！这一点值得我们干一杯！

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers encountered a Raider-infested Super-Duper Mart. Get the jump on those jerks!
ZH: 一名探索废土的居民发现了一个被掠夺者霸占的大无敌超市。抢在这些混蛋之前动手吧！

EN: Hear ye, Hear ye! A fierce and loathsome beast has been terrorizing the villagers throughout the land. Track it to its lair and slay the creature.
ZH: 号外，号外啦！一个凶猛恶心的怪兽占领了村庄，到处恐吓村民。找到它的藏身处并干掉它！

EN: One of your Dwellers encountered a Raider in an abandoned Red Rocket. Stop him before he heads for your Vault!
ZH: 一位居民在废弃的红火箭服务站遇到了一位掠夺者。在他前往你们避难所之前阻止他！

EN: We've searched a few locations, but still haven't found Coach, or the Jersey. Maybe the old Super Duper Mart holds the key!
ZH: 我们搜索了几处地点，但还是没有找到教练，或者棒球衫。也许旧的大无敌超市里能有什么线索。

EN: One of your Wasteland explorers discovered a Super-Duper Mart, but some Raiders beat you to it. Run them off and grab some supplies.
ZH: 一位废土探险者发现了一处大无敌超市，但一些掠夺者捷足先登了。赶跑他们，拿走物资。

EN: For your training mission, Vault-Tec asks you to prove yourself as a worthy Overseer and kill a Glowing Radroach.
ZH: 避难所科技想要你证明自己是一个合格的监督者。作为训练任务，请先杀掉发光辐射蟑螂。
